title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint: Wound care for right heel.

HPI: Pt is a 68-year-old female presenting for follow-up of a pressure ulcer on the right heel. Pt reports the area has been painful but stable over the last week. No new drainage or systemic symptoms reported. Pt currently uses a pressure-relieving mattress at home.

Medication List: 
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Atorvastatin 20mg QD
- Amlodipine 5mg QD

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Denies fever, chills, fatigue.
Integumentary: Reports localized pain at right heel. No new rashes.
MSK: Denies joint pain or swelling.
CV: Denies chest pain or palpitations.
Resp: Denies SOB or cough.
Neuro: Denies numbness or tingling.

Social History: Pt lives at home with spouse. Retired. Non-smoker. Occasional alcohol use.

Family History: Mother had hypertension. Father had stroke.

Vitals:
BP: 138/82
HR: 74 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Ht: 12.4
Wt: 155 lbs

Recent Labs:
HbA1c: 6.4%
eGFR: 78
WBC: 8.2
Hgb: 12.1
Plt: 210k

Exam:
General: Pt in no acute distress, alert and oriented x3.
Skin: Exam of right heel reveals a stage 2 pressure ulcer. Wound measures approximately 2cm x 1.5cm. Bed is pink and moist with minimal serous drainage. No surrounding erythema or purulent discharge. Surrounding skin is intact.
MSK: Strength 5/5 in all extremities.
CV: RRR, regular rhythm.
Resp: CTAB.

Assessment:
1. Stage 2 pressure ulcer on right heel.

Plan:
1. Wound care: Cleanse with normal saline. Apply hydrocolloid dressing to the right heel.
2. Instructions: Maintain offloading of the right heel. Keep dressing dry and intact.
3. F/u: Return to clinic in 2 weeks for wound re-evaluation.

Electronically signed, S. Patel, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, stage 2: L89.612 (HCC 382).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.

hccs.label: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Partial Thickness Skin Loss
